Name: Cloudintel Evidence Blob Reader-Deleter (<SBCI_ENV>)
Description: Least-privilege blob data role for the sbci-WORKER managed identity on the 'evidence' container (plan §6 CI-P6 IaC #3/#4). Grants read + delete on blobs ONLY — the worker reads evidence under the execution lease and deletes it on terminal transitions; it never writes new evidence (that is the API's job). This SPLITS the built-in 'Storage Blob Data Contributor'. Scope the ASSIGNMENT to the evidence container (see ensure_storage_role_assignments in cloudintel-azure.sh); the AssignableScopes below is subscription-wide only because Azure role DEFINITIONS cannot themselves be resource-scoped. NOTE: data-action custom roles can lag RBAC propagation (~5min) on first assignment.
